nextBlocked.locked: This step waits until you are pure.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.body: Pack your ihram and essentials, learn the prohibitions of ihram, and plan where you will pass the miqat.

miqat.title: Miqat
miqat.body: Do not pass the miqat toward Makkah without being in ihram for Umrah. By land, check your distance; by air, set when your flight crosses it.

ihram.title: Enter ihram
ihram.body: At or before the miqat: make ghusl if you can, put on the ihram garments, then make the intention for Umrah. The prohibitions of ihram begin now.

talbiyah.title: Talbiyah
talbiyah.body: Begin the talbiyah once you are in ihram and repeat it often until you begin tawaf.

arrive_haram.title: Arrive at the Haram
arrive_haram.body: Enter Masjid al-Haram with the dua for entering the masjid, then make your way to the Black Stone corner to begin tawaf.

tawaf.title: Tawaf
tawaf.body: Seven circuits around the Ka'bah, keeping it on your left, starting and ending at the Black Stone line.

two_rakah_behind_maqam.title: Two rakahs at Maqam Ibrahim
two_rakah_behind_maqam.body: After tawaf, pray two rakahs behind Maqam Ibrahim if there is room, or anywhere in the masjid when it is crowded.

zamzam.title: Zamzam
zamzam.body: Drink Zamzam water if you can and make dua. It is a recommended practice, not one of the rites of Umrah.

sai.title: Sa'i
sai.body: Seven courses between Safa and Marwah, starting at Safa. Safa to Marwah is one course, and you finish at Marwah. Men walk briskly between the green markers.

halq_taqsir.title: Halq or taqsir
halq_taqsir.body: Leave ihram by shaving or shortening the hair. With this your Umrah is complete.

complete.title: Umrah complete
complete.body: Your Umrah is complete. May Allah accept it from you.

prepare.intention: The intention for Umrah is made in the heart when you enter ihram, and the talbiyah follows it.

direction.marwah_to_safa: Next course: from Marwah to Safa

sai.startHint: Begin at Safa. Each time you reach Marwah or Safa, tap to count the course you just walked.
sai.purityNote: Wudu is recommended for sa'i, but it is not a condition of sa'i in the relied-upon positions of the four schools.

tawaf.startHint: Start at the Black Stone line: face the Black Stone with the takbir below, keep the Ka'bah on your left, and tap at the end of each circuit.
tawaf.noFixedDua: There is no fixed dua for each circuit. Make dua in your own words and language, recite Qur'an and remember Allah. Two remembrances are reported in the Sunnah: the takbir at the Black Stone, and the dua between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone below.
tawaf.doubtBody: If you are unsure, build on the lesser number, the one you are certain of, and complete the rest. A doubt that comes after you have finished is not acted on.

lock.tawaf_purity: Tawaf waits until your hayd or nifas has ended and you have made ghusl. Your ihram stays in place.
lock.salah_purity: The two rakahs come after tawaf and wait until you are pure.
lock.sai_after_tawaf: In Umrah, sa'i comes after tawaf, so it waits until you have made tawaf.
lock.wait: Stay in ihram and keep up your dua and remembrance. When you are pure, make ghusl and continue with tawaf. If your group must leave before then, ask a scholar about your situation.

halq.menBody: Shaving is preferred: the Prophet ﷺ prayed three times for those who shave, and then for those who shorten.
halq.womenBody: Women do not shave. Gather the hair and shorten it by about a fingertip's length.

complete.title: Umrah complete — congratulations
complete.subtitle: May Allah accept your Umrah
complete.body: Your Umrah is complete and the restrictions of ihram are lifted. May Allah accept it from you.
complete.duaBody: There is no fixed dua for this moment. Thank Allah and ask Him for whatever you wish, in any language, for yourself, your family and the Ummah.

qiblaStyles.settingSubtitle: Choose how the Qibla compass looks
qiblaStyles.keywords: qibla, compass, kaaba, direction, dial, design, style, look

classic.name: Classic
classic.desc: The original dial with soft rings, cardinal points and the Kaaba on the rim.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.desc: One thin ring and a large number: the bearing, or the degrees left to turn.

mariner.name: Mariner
mariner.desc: A sailor's compass rose with sixteen points and a dashed course to the Kaaba.

precision.name: Precision
precision.desc: A fine degree scale numbered every 30°, with a crosshair and a fixed heading line.

astrolabe.name: Astrolabe
astrolabe.desc: Brass rings and star pointers inspired by classical Islamic astrolabes.

mihrab.name: Mihrab
mihrab.desc: An eight-pointed star in a tiled border; a mihrab arch marks the qibla.

radar.name: Radar
radar.desc: Range rings and a sweeping beam, with the Kaaba as the contact.

night.name: Night sky
night.desc: A starlit sky where the Kaaba shines as the brightest star.

arrow.name: Bold arrow
arrow.desc: One large arrow on a high-contrast disc — the easiest to read at a glance.
